source.title: Jewelcrafting Alt Army Setup — nominal inputs, mixed output list

notes: Newly examined YouTube setup description lists 4,500 Bismuth, 1,000 Aqirite and 500 Ironclaw alongside a separate materials list, but does not establish those as completed prospecting operations or attribute output stacks to any ore/rank/cast; it mixes preparation/setup materials, so no prospecting yield, probability, skill or resourcefulness denominator is transcribed. Independently checked 2025 Blizzard herbalism report has 461 R1/619 R2/328 R3 Mycobloom gathered for alchemy Thaumaturgy, NOT herb milling. Other ranked original studies and Wowhead Looter reports encountered in search were already recorded, with unresolved build, raw output stack histograms and refund context. Ineligible source candidates are NOT numeric zero outcomes or estimator-eligible observations. No new cohort supported, keep original cast/drop fields unknown.
